render.renderer: CYBR GEO native V10 rebuilt landforms and mineral material layers
render.spectral_method: Jointly transported fixed midpoint wavelength quadrature, 25 nm bins
render.steam_model: Authored heterogeneous density; delta and ratio tracking; HG phase
render.sky_model: Single-scattering spherical Rayleigh/aerosol spectral LUT, not reference-validated
render.material_spectra: Reference-illuminant-calibrated RGB-anchor reflectance, not measured mineral spectra
render.cloud_model: Bounded 3D extinction grid; conservative column-majorant DDA; delta-tracked scattering and ratio-tracked shadows
render.water_reflection_estimator: Primary: GGX VNDF and solar-disc MIS; indirect: one-root macro reflection manifold with exclusive path ownership
render.underwater_direct_light_approximation: One-root macro-surface manifolds approximate indirect reflected and transmitted caustics; primary reflection uses GGX

image.source: Native spectral radiance, not an image-generation model
image.sky_filter_mask: Negative first-opaque-surface material guide only; no landscape pixel changes in sky-only passes
image.filter_space: Linear scene-referred RGB after 16-band CIE integration
image.opaque_mask: Center-ray budget equals ordinary spp and sediment/crust material 0 or 4; disabled if water budget is not higher
image.opaque_policy: Sediment/crust only: convex native/filtered radiance blend, not sharpening or detail synthesis; other materials retain full filtering
